headline: Local AC technician reports 400% surge in bookings from people trying to cool their entire neighborhoods
body: Air conditioning professional Rajesh Sharma confirmed that he has received over 60 requests this week to install industrial-grade cooling units in public parks and open-air apartment balconies to combat the historically intense El Nino heat forecast. Customers reportedly believe that by pointing a window unit toward the street, they can effectively lower the regional temperature for the entire district.
caption: Forget the central AC, this hero is trying to cool the whole colony one window unit at a time. #Heatwave #ElNino #ClimateChange #Indiastories (satire)
igHook: Tag the friend who thinks their tiny room cooler can fight a global weather pattern.
imagePrompt: A close-up shot of a dusty window air conditioning unit mounted precariously in a concrete wall with a blurred city street scene in the background.

sourceHeadline.title: El Nino set to be most intense ‘for over a century’: UK forecasters

judgeVerdict.reasoning: Index 11 captures the perfect 'absurdity as mundane' tone required for satire. It avoids the repetitive 'Local man cancels plans' trope found in most other candidates and presents a vividly funny, specific image—trying to cool an entire public park with a residential window unit—without winking at the audience.
